assets.purpose: Six layers: source with read-only credentials; data client with pagination, rate limiting, and retries; transform producing stable IDs, content, ACLs, and epoch timestamps; a state store; an uploader switching full and incremental with a dead-letter queue; and operations with token rotation and alerts.
assets.source: Authored from claim library; no generated raster, no logo reproduction.

assets.purpose: Four steps: fetch every page and raise on an early empty page; compare the fetched count with the source and the prior run; halt and alert on an anomaly so nothing is finalized; finalize the full run and write the checkpoint only when checks pass.
assets.source: Authored from claim library; no generated raster, no logo reproduction.
assets.creator: Graphics and Media agent (studio)
assets.alt: Four-step completeness guard ending in finalize only on pass.
